description: Interface slice from task-42e9990c. Objective: host recognizes a distinct supervisor exit 82 (DEPENDENCIES_CANDIDATE_INVALID), only on a completely clean no-frame pre-hello session, as code-failure with exitCode 82 and a fixed bounded ASCII diagnostic; existing 81 stays infra-failure. No npm stderr is forwarded. Add this internal exit-code capability and update checkEnvironment's dependency failure descriptor so fresh evidence binds the split. Files: scripts/local-runner/check-session.mjs, scripts/local-runner/check-evidence.mjs, scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs. No guest-supervisor edit: parent task emits 82 only after this host support lands and owns real-guest/repairPolicy integration. Keep all timeout/protocol/abort/kill precedence. Until parent lands, no supervisor emits 82, so old behavior remains compatible. Dependencies serialize the shared test file against 5ed445ca and host-session changes against 92307adc. NOT in scope: daemon repair logic, new JSON frame schemas, live VM certification, local-runner.test.mjs edits, or arbitrary npm diagnostics. Verification from a full external repo snapshot: node --test scripts/tests/local-runner*.test.mjs && (cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test), with daemon npm ci only inside the snapshot. Full runner plus daemon because the outcome/environment contract changes. CQ-R13 remains epic-final integration/native certification owner.
definitionOfDone: Clean stdout EOF and supervisor exit 82 before any frame produce exactly code-failure, exitCode 82, signal null and a fixed nonempty ASCII outputTail no greater than 512 bytes; stdout/stderr cannot supply diagnostic bytes.

Exit 81, absent EOF, failed stdin, provider faults, abort, local kill and malformed/partial/extra frames remain infra-failure; timeout remains timeout; 82 after hello/observation never becomes a candidate refusal or pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Tests first, then minimal host classification. Use the landed 5ed445ca/92307adc/4aa5440b prerequisites; do not copy another worker's dirty source. In local-runner-check.test.mjs, extend C5's real-stream checkProvider/hostCheck/ended table before implementation. New clean no-frame exit82 must resolve exactly to code-failure/82/null and this host-owned literal:
```text
MOE_DEPENDENCY_CANDIDATE_INVALID: Candidate package metadata is not compatible with the approved lockfile; remove npm-shrinkwrap.json/.npmrc and unsupported overrides or bundling.
```
Pin exact bytes independently in tests, ASCII-only, no more than512 UTF8 bytes; changing candidate/nested error/stderr contents (secrets, ANSI, CR/LF, huge Unicode) cannot change it. Assert no observation is needed and a frozen result is still returned. Keep81 infra unchanged. Add82 paired with failed/unfinished stdin write, provider/stream error, abort, local kill, no stdout EOF, partial/bad frames, hello-only, hello+observation, output-before-hello, and a time budget expiring; error handling must retain infra/timeout precedence, never candidate/pass. Preserve all existing C3-C7 assertions and bounded tail/cleanup behavior. Do not yet pin a Python82 constant in C2: this task deliberately does not change the guest producer; parent42e9990c adds that parity test.

In check-session.mjs export DEPENDENCIES_CANDIDATE_INVALID = 82 beside81. In outcomeOf, insert exactly the clean no-frame branch AFTER existing timedOut/failed/killed/written/ended gates, and before the generic unopened-session rejection:
```js
if (code === DEPENDENCIES_CANDIDATE_INVALID && !s.opened) return 'code-failure';
```
In settle, only when that clean candidate branch was actually selected, return result with {code:82,signal:null} and the fixed diagnostic rather than a null observation/empty ring. For instance derive candidateRefusal from outcome==='code-failure', !s.opened and code===82; never special-case raw exit82 before outcomeOf. Ordinary observation-based results remain untouched. The number82 is a SUPERVISOR refusal, not a claimed job exit; update module/JSDoc comments to make this exception explicit. Do not forward stderr, invent protocol frames, change the parser, relax a guard, or change dependency81 semantics.

Update its adjacent comment: confirmed candidate preparation refusals use code repair, infrastructure/unclassified install faults use infra retries; no statement that every dependency failure is infrastructure. Keep source:'host-offline-cache', integrity:'lockfile-sha512', scripts:'ignored', network:'none', all other boundaries and ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX unchanged. Add an explicit old-descriptor oracle comparison: clone the expected descriptor, restore failure:'infra-failure', and assert its identity differs from checkEnvironment(VALID). Preserve key-order invariance and normal freshness checks, including null dependencyDigest. No native certificate is produced by these descriptor tests. This additive host capability lands before the guest begins emitting82, so old guest failures still classify as81/infra; parent task42e9990c owns the producer and actual repair integration.

Output before hello, partial headers and extra frames do not sneak through the no-frame branch; pre-hello stderr is drained unread, never trusted as diagnostics. Check failed stdin and close-before-EOF event ordering, idempotent late close/error handling, timer/listener cleanup and simultaneous sessions' separate state. implementationPlan.note: Adversarial self-review done once on the 3-file diff (check-session +16/-1, check-evidence +7/-2, test +111/-2; 133 added lines). Precedence traced: outcomeOf order is timedOut -> failed/killed/!written/!ended -> 79 -> 82 -> (!opened || !observation) -> 80 -> nonzero -> pass, so 82 can only win on a whole clean session; any frame (even output/observation before hello) fails the decoder path first (first frame must be hello), a hello makes opened true so 82 never matches, and 82 can never reach 'passed' (pass needs code 0). Kill always settles with code null, so killed+82 cannot co-occur; settle's extra `!s.opened` is redundant defence (a code-failure with code 82 is reachable only through the clean branch) and equivalent, not a gap. The diagnostic is a module constant, no interpolation, 173 ASCII bytes <= 512; stderr stays drained unread and the ring/tail is bypassed for this one result. Timers/listeners: settle's cleanup runs before the new early return, so budget/deadline/kill timers and the abort listener are cleared on this path; per-session state is local (C8 runs four concurrent sessions). Scratch mutation sweep (/tmp/moe-a80f-mut/mut.py, 22 single-site mutants, scored by exit code, copies removed): 22/22 killed, including the three the plan names - 82 ordered ahead of the error gates (and ahead of the timeout gate), dropped exitCode, and the old descriptor failure:'infra-failure' - plus ignoring written/ended/failed, signal, tail source, text drift, 81 treated as candidate, constant 83/81, 82->skipped/passed, swapped/renamed leaves, and a descriptor that is not hashed. Probes ran only in scratch; live files hash-equal the gated overlay (7b6919ab/0ed0f851/1317a043), so no gate rerun was needed. Only the 3 owned files changed; guest-supervisor.py, local-runner.test.mjs and the CQ-R13 rows untouched; no non-ASCII added; no pycache left. Hand-off to task-42e9990c: export DEPENDENCIES_CANDIDATE_INVALID=82 from check-session.mjs (parent adds the Python 82 constant and the C2 parity row), host result is {outcome:'code-failure', exitCode:82, signal:null, outputTail: the fixed literal} and the descriptor is CHECK_BOUNDARIES.dependencies.failure = {candidate:'code-failure', infrastructure:'infra-failure'}.
